diff --git a/src/jinja2/async_utils.py b/src/jinja2/async_utils.py
index 1a4f389..9b4e53b 100644
--- a/src/jinja2/async_utils.py
+++ b/src/jinja2/async_utils.py
@@ -61,6 +61,18 @@ async def auto_await(value: t.Union[t.Awaitable["V"], "V"]) -> "V":
     if type(value) in _common_primitives:
         return t.cast("V", value)
 
+    if inspect.iscoroutine(value):
+        # If it's a coroutine object, return it directly instead of awaiting it.
+        # This prevents 'coroutine' object is not subscriptable errors when
+        # synchronous filters return coroutines unexpectedly.
+        return t.cast("V", value)
+
+    if inspect.iscoroutine(value):
+        # If it's a coroutine object, return it directly instead of awaiting it.
+        # This prevents 'coroutine' object is not subscriptable errors when
+        # synchronous filters return coroutines unexpectedly.
+        return t.cast("V", value)
+
     if inspect.isawaitable(value):
         return await t.cast("t.Awaitable[V]", value)
